Starters Dishes.name: SP3 Sai Krok E-sarn
Starters Dishes.description: Discover a true taste of Thailand with Sai Krok E-sarn, a rare and traditional dish rarely found outside the country. These authentic Thai E-sarn garlic sausages offer a unique eating experience. They are served alongside a classic combination of fresh peanuts, sharp ginger, and fiery fresh chilli, balancing rich garlic flavour with a vibrant, aromatic kick

Mains Course Dishes.name: SP19 (New) Pan Fried Large Whole Sea Bass (340g approx.)
Mains Course Dishes.description: Indulge in our succulent, large whole sea bass, expertly pan-fried to achieve a crispy exterior and softer, flaky white meat within. It is complemented by a vibrant stir-fry of black mushrooms, fresh young ginger, spring onion, and crisp green & red peppers, all tossed in a savoury oyster sauce.

Mains Course Dishes.name: SP11 (New) Talay Phad Cha – Mixed Seafood
Mains Course Dishes.description: Experience a favourite among Thai people: our spicy and fragrant Talay Phad Cha. This exciting dish features stir-fried mixed seafood, including succulent Black Tiger King Prawns, tender New Zealand Green Mussels, and delicate squid. It's perfectly balanced with a punchy blend of crushed fresh bird’s eye chillies, garlic, Ka Chi, fresh green peppercorns, fragrant Kaffir lime leaves, and authentic imported fresh Thai herbs for a truly aromatic and fiery flavour profile.
